headline: testf Left Waiting on a Certificate Check
deck: Xhaka, owned by testf, under investigation over his Covid-19 vaccination certificate; no line on availability.
body:
The wire has Granit Xhaka under investigation over an issue with his Covid-19 vaccination certificate. He is testf's, and that is the whole of the draft stake: the league leaders in points scored have a captain in the headlines for something no one has yet attached a timescale to.

What it costs testf, nobody can say. The report offers no ban, no missed fixture, no line on availability. Until it does, Xhaka is a name in an investigation and not a name out of a line-up, and testf plan around him as before.
